services.name: Montgomery County Hospital District EMS (MCHD)
services.evidence: MCHD operates the county's 911 ambulance service, manages the county's Public Health District and offers a variety of community and professional education programs.

services.name: Houston Fire Department
services.area: City of Houston limits within Montgomery County (Kingwood/Lake Houston fringe)
services.evidence: We operate over 100 ambulances and transport units staffed by highly trained paramedics.

48339.page_note: Confirmed: Montgomery County Hospital District (MCHD) runs the county's 911 ambulance service. Not yet confirmed from a public source: who transports in the part of the City of Houston inside the county.
48339.second_source: https://www.fisdap.net/blog/pdfs/2022/07/07/customer-spotlight-q-a-montgomery-county-hospital-district (search result, not opened: MCHD-EMS is the 911 EMS provider for Montgomery County, 1,100 sq mi)

services.name: San Angelo Fire Department
services.evidence: The SAFD provides ambulance service to all of Tom Green County, responding to more than 12,500 ambulance calls a year. The Fire Department's EMS provides advanced life support and transports patients to medical facilities within Tom Green County.

48451.page_note: San Angelo Fire Department provides ground 911 ambulance service to all of Tom Green County; the city's private ambulance permits are for non-emergencies only.

services.name: Odessa Fire Rescue
services.area: whole county (904 sq mi; Ector County is ~901 sq mi)
services.evidence: Odessa Fire Rescue has provided emergency medical services since 1973 ... Operates : 9 Mobile Intensive Care Unit ambulances and 5 reserves ... Covers 904 square miles and serves about 200,000 people

48135.page_note: Confirmed: Odessa Fire Rescue transports in Odessa. Not yet confirmed from a public source: who serves the rest of the county since two new emergency services districts formed in 2025.
